title: Anthony Angel 2000 Grandstand Auto Martinsville Astros Excellent #31 MLB
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This sports trading card features Anthony Angel, a former baseball player for the Houston Astros. The card is an autographed Grandstand Martinsville Astros card from the year 2000. It is a great addition to any collection for fans of the Minor League Baseball (MiLB) and the Astros. The card number is 31 and it is a part of the 2000 Grandstand set. The manufacturer of the card is Grandstand and it has the feature of being an auto card. This trading card is perfect for those who love sports memorabilia and want to add a piece of history to their collection.
